changelog:
Initial release of iphone-use skill — control a physical iPhone via macOS Mirroring.

- Enables real iPhone interaction: operate apps without APIs, export data, control UI, and take screenshots.
- Provides `/agent/status`, `/agent/elements`, and `/agent/input` endpoints for device status, UI element retrieval, and input actions.
- Recommends probing status before action and explains key status fields (`drivable`, `mirror_state`, `human_active`).
- Documents action API for taps, text entry, scrolling, and more, using normalized coordinates or element labels.
- Includes hard-won best practices and troubleshooting for reliable operation and WDA/Mirroring limitations.
- Designed to script both vision-guided and UI-layer-automated workflows for repeated use.
summary: Use when a task needs a real iPhone — operating iOS apps that have no API (Apple Health, banking, IM apps), exporting on-phone data, tapping/typing/scrolling...
